newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy to turn back Albanian refugee boats.
newsitem.headline: Italy to turn back Albanian refugee boats.

text.p: Italy has decided to turn away boats bringing a flood of Albanians to its ports from across the Adriatic, Italian military and Interior Ministry sources said on Monday.

They said the government had issued its directive followed mounting evidence that Albanians who have set out to reach Italy over the past two days were no longer genuine refugees from armed unrest but illegal emigrants looking for a better life.
Nearly 12,000 Albanians have arrived at southeast Italian ports since March 13 in a flotilla of rusting and ancient boats. The exodus resumed on Saturday after a three-day lull caused by bad weather.
"The government has issued instructions that all Albanian vessels which have not obtained Albanian permission to set sail should be turned away," a senior Italian military source told Reuters.
Interior Ministry undersecretary Giannicola Sinisi told reporters that recent arrivals were "men and women from areas which have not even been touched by the revolt".

"They are looking for a better life, better-paid work. In short, they are immigrants," Sinisi said. "I can understand it but we cannot accept them. The law says they should be turned away at the border or repatriated."
